text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 [Torajiro Asuka] from your hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 1 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
